description: Connection pool saturates, downstream calls queue and time out. The timeouts are the symptom, the pool is the cause.

ground_truth.root_cause: The orders-service database connection pool is exhausted. All 20 connections are checked out with 47 requests queued, so callers block until their 30 second acquisition timeout expires. The payment-gateway slowness is a downstream symptom of requests holding connections while waiting, not an independent fault.
ground_truth.distractor_note: A weak RCA blames payment-gateway because its name appears in the loudest log line.
